decisionHistory.nextStep: Complete measured extraction, independent pale grid and shadow, exports, individual static and Vite review, source adoption and publication.
findings: One complete thick square basalt block with rounded perimeter, broad top and two sides in the shared 45-degree elevated view.

Dense charcoal volcanic micrograin, fine pores, softly honed top and restrained bevel light are readable at native resolution. There are no marble veins, lava, landscape, labels or decorative accessories.
The native source has a near-white extraction matte and no visible floor shadow. All four corners and the nearest lower edge are complete.
Scale the whole block uniformly to the shared material-series target size and give it a separate warm survey-paper setting and floor shadow.

nextStep: Preserve this ordinary basalt-block study and its frozen finishing pass. It will not be adopted; create the owner-directed obsidian-and-gemstone Forbidden City corner tower.
